content_md:
"Will it make the boat go faster?" was popularized by Ben Hunt-Davis in his best-selling book about the British men's crew team that won Olympic gold in the 2000 Sydney Games.

It can be useful to identify a "North Star" for guidance and focus. In personal life, this could include:
- are grades / test results / salary higher than my peers
- are my grades / test results / salary increasing
- is my family thriving
- is my net worth increasing
- is physical health increasing - can touch toes, do 100 pushups in a row, complete a marathon, [get wood at age 48](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bryan_Johnson)
- is lifestyle increasing - sleep quality, healthy diet, meaningful social connections, access to experiences and things
- is spiritual health increasing - awareness of the Divine, alignment of actions with values, intimacy with the Creator

---

Here's the evolution of my net worth. It's somewhat under my control, but it's somewhat out of my control:

- ✅ 2016
- ✅ 2017
- 〰️ 2018
- ✅ 2019
- ✅ 2020
- ✅ 2021 [global pandemic]
- ❌ 2022
- ✅ 2023
- ✅ 2024
- 〰️ 2025

**Scorecard: 7/10 up, 1/10 down**
